# Version numbering scheme

This project uses Semantic Versioning (SemVer) for its version numbers. The recorded rationale is that API compatibility matters far more than publication dates, so version numbers are meant to signal compatibility changes rather than when a release was published.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
